root.title: DMX-ADHD-COGNITIVE-REMEDIATION: make the ADHD/cognitive layer real, honest, consolidated
root.summary: Full-build remediation of the ADHD/cognitive/user-facing layer per the 2026-05-31 audit. 8 tracks, ~39 commit-sized TPs. Engine stays cognitive-only (AGENTS.md §6); confidence-band UX; per-user baselines; content-free local-only signal. Each leaf authors a canonical TP at execution time.

T2 Wire the already-built ADHD UX (max-3, gentle errors)
T5 Context preservation: canonical writer + real auto-save
T8 Signal validation, safety rails & observability
